subject: general
question: What is the name of the initiative launched by Union Ministry of Tribal Affairs in June 2025, which is aimed at strengthening the delivery of tribal welfare schemes by training and inspiring a new generation of dedicated implementers?
solution: The correct answer is __**Adi Karmyogi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Adi Karmyogi** is an initiative launched by the **Union Ministry of Tribal Affairs** in **June 2025**. • The program is designed to **strengthen the delivery of tribal welfare schemes** by focusing on training and inspiring a **new generation of implementers**. • The initiative aims to **equip individuals** with the necessary skills, knowledge, and dedication to ensure the effective implementation of government programs tailored for tribal communities. • It is aligned with the government's broader vision of **empowering tribal communities** and addressing the unique challenges they face, including social, economic, and cultural barriers. • The program is expected to create a cadre of **committed professionals** who will work as change-makers in tribal areas by ensuring the efficient delivery of welfare schemes.
